senses.en_definition: To want something and look forward to receiving it or having it happen.

collocations.en: hope to be able to help

messages.en: Has the place you interviewed at got back to you yet?
Not yet. I really hope I get that job. I'm tired of job hunting.
Hopefully you'll get some good news soon. If you get it, make sure you tell me!
This gift really means a lot to me, even though it's only something small.
I've still got the gift you gave me ages ago, too. It's been a long time, but it's still in good shape.
Your method actually worked! I can log in now.
Great! Just do it the same way next time.

senses.en_definition: To stop moving, operating, or continuing an activity.
To cease or come to an end, as rain or crying does.
To resign from a job or cease to be a member or subscriber.
To pause an activity to rest.

messages.en: Do you guys want to stop at the rest area up ahead? I just want to grab a drink.
Yeah, let's meet there. We're getting hungry too.
